claims.statement: PTQ converts an already trained fixed model without a weight-update step; basic weight-only maxabs quantization needs weight ranges, while activation ranges can be estimated dynamically or calibrated statically. This conversion differs from QAT.
claims.scope: Basic symmetric weight-only PTQ in this repository; not a statement that all advanced PTQ techniques are calibration-free.

evidence.supports: Official workflow distinctions and dynamic/weight-only path without activation calibration.
